name: Today's Sky
source:
The story follows Lucy, a spiteful 19-year-old woman seeking to break free from the grasp of her captors and find independence. In the circumstances of a relationship that relies heavily on punishment and confiscation, she abandons all of her possessions in the name of that elusive freedom. Yet, there was one thing left she didn't realize she had yet given up: her dignity.
